result.title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
result.summary: Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AuroraWorld，用结构化 4D 世界建模从第三人称机器人操作视频合成第一人称视角视频，以缓解自视角数据采集成本高的问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于面向策略学习的视频生成与数据合成，摘要未涉及 latent 推理状态、证据使用或停止决策等机制，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
